status.summary: Former UFC featherweight and lightweight champion. He came back from a five-year layoff to fight Max Holloway at UFC 329 (Jul 11, 2026, Las Vegas; filed at welterweight) and lost by TKO at 1:09 of R1 after injuring his leg. ufcstats records the result as 'McGregor knee injury'; coverage cited in the Holloway dossier says he buckled his right leg throwing a kick. That was his first fight since he broke down at the end of R1 against Dustin Poirier at UFC 264 (Jul 10, 2021, doctor's stoppage). He has lost four of his last five UFC fights. The Holloway dossier cites UFCalendar saying both men have talked about a third fight; nothing is booked in the dataset. The diagnosis, treatment, retirement status and future plans could not be checked on the web this session.

injuries.what: Right leg/knee injury throwing a kick early in R1 at UFC 329; the fight was stopped at 1:09 (ufcstats: 'McGregor knee injury'). Diagnosis, surgery and recovery timeline were not verified this session.
Leg injury at the end of R1 vs Poirier, ended by doctor's stoppage (ufcstats). Widely reported as a fractured left lower leg (recalled; not re-checked this session).

signature: the counter left hand: knocked out Jose Aldo with one punch at 0:13 of R1 for the featherweight title (UFC 194, 2015); that it was a counter is recalled, and ufcstats records 'Punch to Head At Distance'
one-punch power: 13 knockdowns in 15 UFC fights, including three each against Eddie Alvarez (UFC 205, lightweight title) and Nate Diaz (UFC 202)
leg kicks to Diaz's lead leg in the rematch: 40 of 45 leg strikes landed (UFC 202)
body work in the featherweight run: 15 of 30 body strikes vs Chad Mendes, 12 of 16 vs Dennis Siver
a 40-second finish of Donald Cerrone: 3 of 3 clinch strikes and a knockdown, then ground punches (the shoulder strikes and head kick are recalled from footage)
weaknesses: wrestling and top control: Khabib Nurmagomedov landed 3 of 7 takedowns, held 12:14 of control and finished with a rear-naked choke in R4 (UFC 229); Mendes held 5:19 of control; opponents average 250 s of control per 15 min against him career (lightweight league 171)
calf kicks: Poirier landed 18 of 21 leg strikes before the R2 KO at UFC 257 (2021)
submitted twice by rear-naked choke (Diaz R2 2016, Khabib R4 2018)
two fight-ending leg injuries: the doctor's stoppage at UFC 264 (2021) and the knee injury at UFC 329 (2026)
inactivity and form: one fight (69 seconds) since Jul 2021, 1-4 in his last five UFC fights, age 38
style.summary: A southpaw counter-puncher with rare one-punch power. His left hand produced most of his eight UFC knockouts (which hand is recalled; ufcstats does not record it), five of them in the first round. His long reach and kicking range back it up. He has struggled whenever a fight turned into a wrestling match or a calf-kick battle. He has barely fought since 2021, and both of his last two fights ended with his own leg injuries.

moves.notes: Weights follow the schema example and src/director.js: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1; spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for specials. He is a southpaw, so 'cross' here is the rear left straight and 'hook' the lead right hook. src/director.js MOVE_TXT names these 'right hand' and 'left hook', so the page text needs a stance flip. Target split from fighters.json: career significant attempts are 78.8% head, 13.1% body, 8.2% legs (landed 69.9/17.0/13.0), close to the lightweight league (76.6/14.7/8.7). The time-decayed split (80.6/12.0/7.4) rests on only 5.8 minutes. No web scouting source could be read this session. The cross gets the largest head share because his KOs are built on the left hand (Aldo, Mendes, Alvarez, Siver are all 'Punch to Head At Distance' in ufcstats; the hand is recalled). Head kick gets 0.10 because of the recalled head kick vs Cerrone. Body kicks lead the body group because front and teep kicks to the body are a recalled staple. The body straight reflects 15 of 30 body strikes vs Mendes. Legs are split evenly; ufcstats does not separate calf from inside kicks, and his recalled oblique kicks to the knee have no director move. spinning 0.05 reflects recalled spinning kicks; knee and elbow are small. Low confidence.

appearance.build: 5 ft 9 in with a 74 in reach (ufcstats), long-armed for his height; has fought at 145, 155 and 170 lb (UFC 329 was filed at welterweight)
appearance.hair: short dark-brown hair; style varies (recalled; check)
appearance.facial_hair: full reddish beard in most fights since the mid-2010s; length varies (recalled; check)
appearance.notes: Height and reach are from ufcstats. Hair, beard and skin are recalled from widely published fight photos and were not re-checked this session (no web or image host was reachable). Tattoos and kit were not sourced, so both are left unknown.

engine_notes.note: Knockdown power: 13 knockdowns in 113.7 UFC minutes, 1.72 per 15 min and 3.1 per 100 head strikes landed (lightweight league 0.34 per 15 and 0.87 per 100). Head accuracy is 44% career (league 39%).

Fast starts: 5 of his 8 KO/TKO wins came in R1 (Brimage 1:07, Brandao 4:05, Poirier 1:46, Aldo 0:13, Cerrone 0:40). He lands 5.0 significant strikes per minute in R1 of 5-round fights. Rounds 3-5 rest almost entirely on Diaz II and Khabib, so the pace curve (1.00, 1.10, 1.19, 1.28, 0.95) is weak evidence.

Time-decayed sums cover only 5.8 minutes, so his engine rates are mostly priors plus 2013-2021 career data. fighters.json files him at Welterweight because UFC 329 is his only fight in the 3 years before the snapshot; 7 of his 15 UFC fights were at featherweight and 4 each at lightweight and welterweight.

Grappling defence: his takedown defence is 67% career (lightweight league 64%), but opponents average 250 s of control per 15 min against him (league 171). Elite wrestlers (Khabib, Mendes) controlled him for long spells.

Chin: only 1 knockdown absorbed in 15 UFC fights (0.27 per 100 head strikes absorbed). His two KO/TKO losses in ko_losses are Poirier at UFC 257 (after 18 leg strikes) and the UFC 329 injury stoppage; the UFC 264 doctor's stoppage is excluded.
Form and health: 1-4 in his last five UFC fights, one 69-second fight since Jul 2021, and leg injuries ended both of his last two fights. The engine should discount his career rates heavily.
